description: Defines ORM models for a manufacturing OEE monitoring system, including classes for lines, shifts, runs, events, and alerts.

classes.name: Base
classes.description: Base class for all ORM models.

classes.name: EventType
classes.description: Enumeration of event types for OEE calculations.

classes.name: AlertType
classes.description: Enumeration of alert types emitted by the system.

classes.name: Line
classes.description: Represents a production line with target OEE and related runs and shifts.

classes.name: Shift
classes.description: Represents a work shift associated with a line, with start and end timestamps.

classes.name: Run
classes.description: Represents a production run with associated product info, timing, events, and alerts.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Represents an event during a run, such as production, downtime, or quality adjustments.

classes.name: Alert
classes.description: Represents alerts triggered during production, with severity and acknowledgment status.
